chunks: From him, from several of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from Hammad ibn Uthman, who said:

I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying: 'There is no breastfeeding (creating kinship) after weaning.' I said: 'May I be your ransom, what is weaning?' He said: 'The two years which Allah the Exalted said.'
ai.seo_question: What is the age limit for breastfeeding to establish kinship in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies that the legal effect of *radha'* (breastfeeding) in establishing kinship is limited to the first two years, a period known as *hawl*, thereby preventing the proliferation of mahram relationships beyond this timeframe. This ruling aligns with the Quranic prescription in Surah Al-Baqarah, ensuring that the prohibition of marriage based on breastfeeding does not extend indefinitely, thus maintaining clarity in familial laws.
